description: This file defines the Options class which encapsulates command line argument parsing logic for the Android bugreport tool. It includes fields for various input files and parsing error handling, along with a static method for parsing arguments.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Class to encapsulate the command line arguments and parsing logic for the Android bugreport tool.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses an array of command line arguments and returns an Options object containing the parsed data or error information.
